reuse.reason: The pinned official AccountSection and SignInDialog use a Platform browser authorization attempt, not local Better Auth username/email/password authentication. Mounting or forking that flow retains the incompatible Platform account contract; the Models ApiKeyInput and SettingsSecretField manage provider credentials rather than local-account sign-in. This custom local-account plugin therefore owns only the account flow and composes unchanged Modal, Button, Input and icons from the stable ui-primitives export. The default official Modal header, description, close control, mask, focus lifecycle and theme tokens provide the presentation; local CSS only arranges the flow and semantic messages. The existing reviewed theme presenter supports standalone /login. The user retained the local multi-step flow but superseded the former ChatGPT appearance request with official DSH visuals on 2026-11-17. Authentication and registration policy remain server-owned.

userApprovedDeviations.change: Retain local username/email then password, registration, action-level anonymous sign-in prompts and visible unavailable social/phone providers. The visual surface uses unchanged official Modal, Button and Input; the former ChatGPT dimensions, colors, typography and corner overrides are removed. This is a local account-flow adaptation, not a separate visual theme.
userApprovedDeviations.approval: On 2026-11-17 the user retained the dialog structure and local-account flow while requiring official DSH components and styling, superseding the earlier ChatGPT visual request.
